acceptanceCriteria: Policy may declare a cleanup (and health) bound above 300 s up to a documented maximum (for example 3600 s); the default and existing validation for other fields are unchanged.
memberConfig may name a pinned external repository or worktree as cwd with revision pinning (configRef style); an unpinned or moved checkout is refused, not silently run.
The pool safe-reuse spec states both changes and their failure modes.
Maintained tests cover the extended bound accepted and enforced, an over-maximum bound refused, and the pinned external cwd accepted, mismatched pin refused.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 from GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#628 (orchestrator triage; reporter observations on main-2fff511, not reproduced yet).

memberConfig health/cleanup are bounded at timeoutSeconds 1..300 and must run with cwd REPOSITORY. Container lane resets take 3-5 min (over 17 min under load) and their scripts live in another repository, so the reporter runs an external sweeper that failed silently for hours.

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#632, merged to main as 265835f77f9aca1175dfeac06ee7e63ecf17a805. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-v1-0857-pool-member-config-bounds.md at that commit (the digest is that file's sha256), which records the change, the maintained tests the acceptance criteria name, the independent Codex review and its repairs. The batch head passed the doc gates, go vet, the full suites of the touched packages on darwin and every hosted CI check (go-product shards, doc-gates, go-interop). NOT_RUN: make gate, live multi-agent/dispatcher qualification and non-darwin execution where that entry says so.

title: corvint-tasks pool memberConfig: allow longer cleanup bounds and a pinned external cwd so container environments can use native pool sweep (issue #628)
